notes.subject: wemdan
notes.rationale: גבר d argaz azayan / amiḍan; yeffɣen d 'wemdan' ilaqen ad yeqqim d talɣa-is tamcetṭuḥt

notes.subject: דרכו יחפץ
notes.rationale: anwa i yessaram: Yahwe deg webrid n wemdan (KJV, JPS) neɣ wemdan deg webrid-is (Geneva, BSB); talɣa taɛbranit tzemmer ad tawi snat

notes.subject: כוננו / יחפץ
notes.rationale: sin n yifeḍlanen s wemdan: asbeddi d usirem, tanila n teckmint tettwaxleḍ deg tsuqilt

translation: Seg Yahwe i d-ttwasbedden iḍerren n wemdan, ṭtaf deg webrid-is ayen yessaram.
